question: Weathering leads to formation of _____.
solution:
The correct answer is "**soil".** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Weathering** describes the **breaking** down or** dissolving of rocks **and minerals on the **surface** of the earth.
 
• Weathering **occurs **when **physical processes affect the rock,** such as **changes in temperature** or when the rock is** exposed to the effects of wind, rain, and waves.**
 
• **Water,** ice, acids, salts, **plants, animals,** and changes in** temperature** are all **agents **of weathering.
 
• Thus, this** weathering **which leads to both the **mechanical breakup of rocks** and the **chemical weathering of minerals** contributes to soil formation.
 
• *Therefore,** **weathering leads to soil formation*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 __**Formation**__
 
 

 **Cyclones**
 
 
 
• When **warm**, humid** air** **rises** **over** the **water**, a cyclone is created.
 
• There is the development of a low-pressure area beneath as this air rises.
 
• The **high-pressure** air from the surroundings is now blown into the **low-pressure **area.
 
 
 
 

 **Icebergs**
 
 
 
• When **chunks** of** ice** **fall** off the edge of an ice cap or a **glacier **that is flowing into the ocean, icebergs are created.
 
• The phenomenon of ice **melting** around the borders of glaciers and **ice sheets** is known as "**calving**," and it occurs naturally.
 
 
 
 

 **Clouds**
 
 
 
• Clouds are generated as a result of **evaporation** accompanied by **condensation**.
 
• Sunlight causes water on the earth's surface to evaporate, which causes the** water **to **ascend **into the **sky**.
 
• Water **vapor **in the air **condenses **at a specific height to create minute **droplets** of water.
 
• These water droplets assemble into clouds that float in the atmosphere.
